therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PD-1 blockade enhances T-cell activity while EGFR inhibition blocks tumor growth signals and mediates ADCC
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: immune activation combined with growth factor receptor inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

context.indication: recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

modulation_entries.hypothesis: EGFR inhibition and ADCC may enhance immune-mediated tumor rejection by PD-1 blockade
modulation_entries.citation: Cetuximab can mediate antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC), with in vitro assays and in vivo animal studies demonstrating that cetuximab inhibits the growth and survival of tumor cells expressing EGFR
